name: Verify the mark sold functionality in "In Transit" Tab for Mitchell Subaru

steps.name: Click the login button to open login popup
Click the "Next" button after entering email
Handle "Stay Signed In" prompt if it appears
Wait for selector getByRole('heading', { name: 'Hi Mitchell Subaru , Good' })
Navigate to Vehicles page from side navbar
Wait for selector locator('//a[contains(@class, "nav-link") and contains(text(),"In Transit")]')
Get text content locator('//a[contains(@class, "nav-link") and contains(text(),"In Transit")]')
Select the vehicle with highest inventory in active tab
Get text content locator('tr').getByLabel('is template cell column header Window Sticker & VIN/Invoice').first()
Click and extract VIN from the first vehicle row (any status)
Wait for selector locator('table tbody tr.e-row').first()
Click on VIN voice in first row
Wait for VIN modal and extract VIN
Mark vehicle as Not Sold for Stock#: "7"
Wait for selector getByRole('button', { name: 'Edit Stock', exact: true }).first()
Click getByRole('button', { name: 'Edit Stock', exact: true }).first()
Wait for selector getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Stock Number' })
Fill "Mark as not sold - automated" getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Comment' })
Wait for selector getByRole('checkbox', { name: 'Mark as Sold' })
Is checked getByRole('checkbox', { name: 'Mark as Sold' })
Validate that column "soldStatus" contains text: "not sold"
Mark vehicle as Sold for Stock#: "7"
Wait for selector getByRole('button', { name: 'Edit Stock', exact: true }).first()
Click getByRole('button', { name: 'Edit Stock', exact: true }).first()
Wait for selector getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Stock Number' })
Fill "Mark as sold - toggle back" getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Comment' })
Wait for selector getByRole('checkbox', { name: 'Mark as Sold' })
Is checked getByRole('checkbox', { name: 'Mark as Sold' })
Wait for selector locator('li.user > div.logout-btn > button[aria-label="Logout"]')
